environment.tool: manual audit of the final tag source + live compiled binary; raw-socket client sending exact bytes, strict-token upstream peer logging verbatim request bytes and byte count

findings.description: Unlike its siblings this build concatenates r.target - the raw, still-encoded target - so %0d%0a stays literal on the wire and the response is a single, well-formed 301. The decoded path is used for routing but not for the header. Recorded so the weak-guard family is not over-claimed.
findings.title: The 301 Location is rebuilt from the raw target, so a decoded CRLF directory does not split

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
methods: Control request first on the same config
Raw client bytes and raw upstream bytes captured in hex
Payload diffed against the control line
